%% A plot carrying values inside the figure: a panel title with a score, an
%% isolated value annotation, plus ordinary aligned tick labels (not values).
\documentclass[border=0pt]{standalone}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1.33cm, every node/.style={font=\fontsize{7.5}{9}\selectfont}]
\draw (0,0) rectangle (8,4);
\draw[thick] (0,0.5) -- (2,1.5) -- (4,2.2) -- (6,3) -- (8,3.4);
\foreach \x in {0.0,0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0} {\node[below] at (\x*4,-0.1) {\x};}
\foreach \y in {0.25,0.50,0.75} {\node[left] at (-0.1,\y*4) {\y};}
\node[below left] at (7.8,3.9) {Model A (acc = 0.93)};
\node at (5,1.2) {0.87};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
